data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 asserts compatibility between a 'fragmentation firewall' (SRC_004) and a 'stochastic filter' (SRC_002), but the compatibility is not grounded in any shared mechanism actually shown. The target claims both 'prevent propagation of single-point-of-failure triggers,' yet it offers no reason a stochastic filter and a fragmentation firewall operate by the same principle — one filters probabilistically, the other isolates by partitioning. The relation is asserted by verbal gloss ('both describe the mechanism'), and the refutation condition switches to a different axis (operational vs software-stack heterogeneity) without tying back to whether the two named mechanisms are genuinely compatible. This is an unsupported compatibility claim dressed as a relation, not a substantive one.
